ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central surface area estimated at 80-85% against low-intensity (black) peripheral boundaries and internal linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white central field; solid black banding along the leading edge and trailing edge periphery; dense clusters of black mottling and vertical streaks concentrated at the peduncle insertion and lower-left/right quadrants.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped central depression with a wide interior angle and moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; notably deep, jagged pixel-valleys on the left lobe's distal half and irregular micro-peaks along the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the outer leading edges, tapering to sharp distal tips with an upward-swept orientation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small dark circular clusters visible within the peripheral black borders of the left lobe and distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent, unaligned dark linear streaks and rake-like disruptions located in the lower-central and lower-left regions of the white ventral field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular erosion/missing tissue at the far left distal tip; multiple deep notches and ragged tissue loss along the trailing edge of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical 'drip' patterns of black pigmentation descending from the trailing edge into the white field on the right lobe lobe; concentrated dark vertical scarring near the central notch.
